name: forgejo
title: Forgejo
description: Self-hosted Git service for hosting repositories, code review, issue tracking, and collaboration.
note: Forgejo (FOOS Gitea fork) container image. Creates a random password for PostgreSQL using docker compose secrets. When initializing Forgejo, don't change this password (it auto-populates).

env.name: CONTAINER_NAME
env.label: Container name
env.description: Base name used for the Forgejo and PostgreSQL Docker container names.

env.name: FORGEJO_VERSION
env.label: Version:
env.description: Select the Forgejo image tag. View available tags and releases: https://codeberg.org/forgejo/-/packages/container/forgejo/versions?q=&sort=created_desc&tagged=tagged

env.name: FORGEJO_DATA_DIR
env.label: Data folder
env.description: REQUIRED. Absolute path on the Docker host for Forgejo's persistent data, configuration, repositories, and SQLite database.

env.name: FORGEJO_HTTP_PORT
env.label: Web UI host port
env.description: Host port mapped to Forgejo's HTTP port 3000.

env.name: FORGEJO_SSH_PORT
env.label: SSH host port
env.description: Host port mapped to Forgejo's rootless SSH port 2222. This value is also advertised in SSH clone URLs.
